name: Deep Subsea AUV Sabotage
description: A submerged AUV conducting a survey is attacked through its acoustic positioning chain: first a USBL two-way-travel-time delay-skew biases its believed position, then the acoustic transponder channel is jammed into a blackout, denying position fixes entirely.

stages.name: Submerged Survey Underway
stages.narrative: AUV holds depth and tracks its survey line on USBL + DVL + dead-reckoning fusion. Acoustic link nominal.

stages.name: USBL Acoustic Delay-Skew Spoofing
stages.narrative: Forged transponder replies inject a growing two-way-travel-time bias, skewing the acoustic range and walking the believed subsea position.

stages.name: Acoustic Transponder Jamming (Blackout)
stages.narrative: The attacker floods the acoustic band, denying USBL fixes. The vehicle must survive on inertial dead-reckoning alone.
